rubric_feedback: Additional valid comparisons were confirmed with the tools: Q11's 351.302(g) changes 'whether the employees prefer' and information to 'the employee' into 'whether each employee prefers' and information to 'each employee' (proposal lines 2879–2884; final lines 5104–5109). Q13 item 5 identifies a genuine criteria discrepancy: the preamble at 91 FR 49198 points multiple-pattern transmutation to 351.503(d)'s criteria, including special-act/service awards, while 351.503(e)(1)(i) supplies a narrower operative award list. Q14's 351.902(a) changes reconsideration 'of an initial appeal' to 'of an initial decision'; this is absent from the summary of changes and counts as one wording-only item. These supplement the key rather than contradicting its expected answers.
